interpretation.likely_demands_provisional: Unconditional protein sequence distribution modeling and learned sequence/structure regularities; specialist representations may be essential.
interpretation.information_supplied_to_solver: Verified source start prefix only; no actual dispatch.
interpretation.reference_answer_source: No per-case gold sequence; output cohort statistics and external folding-confidence predictor.
interpretation.good_score_establishes: Declared cohort length, diversity and folding confidence under the frozen pipeline; not novelty, measured function, laboratory folding or explanation correctness.
interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Limited delivery or cohort proxy properties under the declared adaptation; not absence of all protein reasoning capability.

tasks.partial_native_metric_feasibility: Native property scores require the actual trained classifiers. Generic length or lexical heuristics cannot substitute for stability/solubility. Prompt inventory alone is not a run-ready benchmark and does not authorize invented balanced replicates.

interpretation.likely_demands_provisional: Conditioned protein sequence generation, property-associated sequence regularities and learned biophysical representations.
interpretation.information_supplied_to_solver: Legitimate condition text only; no oracle probabilities, natural-reference IDs or sequence exemplars; no actual dispatch.
interpretation.reference_answer_source: Trained classifier proxy probabilities and a separate natural UR50 reference cohort.
interpretation.good_score_establishes: Frozen classifier confidence/threshold frequency under the declared generation protocol; not measured stability/solubility or rationale correctness.
interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Poor condition delivery or property-predictor agreement under the declared protocol; not proof that outputs are experimentally unstable or insoluble.

omega_fold_future_dependency.native_confidence_aggregation_warning: OmegaFold get_all_confidence uses local-neighbor-weighted residue confidence; NatureLM average pLDDT does not identify that aggregation versus an unweighted residue mean. Do not silently substitute either.
omega_fold_future_dependency.existing_frozen_oracle_environment_must_: Keep .venv-oracles frozen for P42; any future OmegaFold installation needs a separate reviewed runtime.

call_compute_estimates.generation: N37 + Nstable + Nsoluble + Ninsoluble requests if n=1; native batching is unknown.
call_compute_estimates.maximum_output_token_work: Sum of N_condition × native_token_limit_condition; native counts and limits are unknown.
call_compute_estimates.P37_fold_items: Eligible valid outputs shorter than 100 residues, at most N37; do not infer counts from histogram plots.
call_compute_estimates.P38_predictor_items_if_exactreference_re: Nstable + Nsoluble + Ninsoluble + 2000 natural-reference items (1000 for each classifier); actual batch counts are unknown.
call_compute_estimates.reason: Without native counts/limits, workload and an authorized timing forward, numerical wall-clock estimates would be unsupported. Reuse the existing Qwen checkpoint; no extra generator storage is needed.

proposal_decision.reason: Exact native budgets and metrics cannot currently be preserved. These remain valid biological generation tasks, blocked by protocol/oracle/reference gaps rather than text-interface suitability.
proposal_decision.future_resolution: Recover author generation manifest, sampling/validity rules, cluster command, OmegaFold version/weights/settings/aggregation, both trained property heads, and UR50 snapshot/IDs. Freeze a qualified Qwen input/channel/termination condition and denominator before any calls; lock all outputs before external oracle scoring; retain unresolved metrics as null.
